```{r Setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(grid)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggnewscale)

# Global Parameters
cancer <- "LIHC"
```

# Plot Time

Now it's time to plot our interactions!

```{r Load Data}
interactions <- read.csv(paste0(cancer, "_prioritized_permuted.csv"), row.names = 1)

plot_data <- interactions |>
  # Select top sender per triad
  group_by(ligand, receptor, receiver) |>
  slice_max(sender_score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # Aggregate across receptors
  group_by(receiver, ligand, sender) |>
  summarise(
    sender_ligand = dplyr::first(abs(sender_ligand)),
    sum_interaction = sum(interaction_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_receptor = receptor[which.max(abs(interaction_score))],
    top_interaction = max(abs(interaction_score)),
    direction = if_else(
      interaction_score[which.max(abs(interaction_score))] > 0,
      "Increased Survival", 
      "Decreased Survival"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sender_ligand_pair = paste(ligand, sender, sep = "+"),
    label = paste(sender, receiver, ligand, top_receptor, sep = "+")
  )

sender_colors2 <- c(
  "dodgerblue3", "red", "goldenrod2", "darkorchid4", "seagreen1",
  "firebrick", "mediumblue", "darkorange3", "turquoise2", "springgreen4",
  "darkcyan", "chartreuse3", "slateblue3", "mediumvioletred", "tan4",
  "yellow", "magenta", "black", "lavender", "mediumorchid3",
  "steelblue3", "moccasin", "coral", "olivedrab", "lightslateblue",
  "cornsilk4", "azure3", "bisque3", "cadetblue4", "chocolate4", "darkolivegreen",
  "darkslategray", "hotpink4", "honeydew", "khaki3", "lightsalmon2", "seashell",
  "thistle2", "plum4", "royalblue1", "orangered2", "forestgreen",
  "darkgoldenrod1", "purple3", "cyan3", "indianred3", "navy", "darkmagenta",
  "chartreuse1", "mediumturquoise", "tomato3", "gold3", "darkseagreen4",
  "dodgerblue4", "sienna3", "darkred", "skyblue2", "violetred1", "darkslateblue",
  "palegreen3", "salmon3", "lightcoral", "mediumseagreen", "blue4",
  "mediumspringgreen", "slategray3", "mediumslateblue", "orange4", "darkkhaki"
)
```

# All Interactions Graph

```{r Plot All Interactions}
# Data Prep & Limits
plot_data_all <- plot_data |>
  mutate(abs_sum_interaction = abs(sum_interaction))

raw_breaks <- pretty(plot_data_all$abs_sum_interaction, n = 5)
raw_breaks <- raw_breaks[raw_breaks > 0]
n_breaks <- length(raw_breaks)

dynamic_breaks <- c(raw_breaks, raw_breaks + 0.1)
dynamic_labels <- as.character(c(raw_breaks, raw_breaks))
dynamic_shapes <- c(rep(16, n_breaks), rep(15, n_breaks))
dynamic_limits <- c(
  min(c(raw_breaks, plot_data_all$abs_sum_interaction), na.rm = TRUE),
  max(c(dynamic_breaks, plot_data_all$abs_sum_interaction), na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Plot Generation
p_all <- ggplot(plot_data_all, aes(x = sender_ligand_pair)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = receiver, size = abs_sum_interaction, color = top_receptor, shape = direction)) +
  geom_tile(aes(y = -0.5, fill = abs(sender_ligand)), width = 0.4, height = 0.4, color = "grey") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Receptor", values = sender_colors2) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Outcome", values = c(16, 15)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(name = "Sender Score", low = "white", high = "red") +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Interaction Score",
    range = c(1, 10),
    limits = dynamic_limits,
    breaks = dynamic_breaks,
    labels = dynamic_labels,
    guide = guide_legend(
      ncol = 2,
      byrow = FALSE,
      override.aes = list(shape = dynamic_shapes, color = "black")
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Ligand/receptor pairs associated with significant survival in ", cancer),
    x = "Ligand",
    y = "Receiver"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 50, 10)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(order = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

print(p_all)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(cancer, "_all_interactions.pdf"),
  plot = p_all,
  units = "in", dpi = 300, height = 15, width = 15
)
```

# Direction-Specific Interactions

```{r Helper Plotting Function}
# Helper to reduce duplication across direction plots
plot_interaction_subset <- function(data, target_direction, shape_val, title_text) {
  filtered_data <- data |> filter(direction == target_direction)
  sender_dots <- filtered_data |> select(sender, ligand, sender_ligand, sender_ligand_pair)

  ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = sender_ligand_pair, y = receiver)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = abs(sum_interaction), color = top_receptor), shape = shape_val) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sender_colors2, name = "Receptor") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Interaction Score", range = c(1, 10)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title_text, x = "Ligand", y = "Receiver") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 50, 10),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    ggnewscale::new_scale("size") +
    geom_tile(
      data = sender_dots,
      aes(x = sender_ligand_pair, y = -0.5, fill = abs(sender_ligand)),
      width = 0.4, height = 0.4, color = "grey", inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(name = "Sender Score", low = "white", high = "red") +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(order = 1))
}
```

# Circle Plot (Chord Diagram)

A chord diagram of all of the interactions between cell types. Relationship strength is denoted by thickness and direction by color. This code does not work in RMarkdown, so paste into R console to run.

```{r Chord Diagram Plot}
# Edge List & Dynamic Colors
edges <- interactions |>
  group_by(sender, receiver) |>
  summarize(value = sum(interaction_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(value != 0) |>
  rename(from = sender, to = receiver)

present_cells <- sort(unique(c(edges$from, edges$to)))
cell_colors <- setNames(sender_colors2[seq_along(present_cells)], present_cells)

# Color Mapping & Legend Breaks
max_abs <- max(abs(edges$value))
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-max_abs, 0, max_abs), c("blue", "white", "red"))

breaks <- pretty(c(-max_abs, max_abs), n = 5)
range_limit <- max(abs(breaks))
breaks <- pretty(c(-range_limit, range_limit), n = 5)

# Render Plot
pdf(paste0(cancer, "_chord_diagram.pdf"), width = 15, height = 15)

circos.clear()
circos.par(
  canvas.xlim = c(-0.9, 1.7),
  canvas.ylim = c(-1.3, 1.3),
  gap.after = 2
)

chordDiagram(
  edges,
  grid.col = cell_colors,
  transparency = 0.5,
  annotationTrack = "grid",
  preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.1),
  col = col_fun(edges$value),
  directional = 1,
  direction.type = "arrows",
  link.arr.type = "big.arrow",
  link.sort = TRUE,
  link.largest.ontop = TRUE
)

# Draw Legend
packed_lgd <- packLegend(
  Legend(
    col_fun = col_fun,
    title = "Interaction\nStrength",
    at = breaks,
    direction = "vertical",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16),
    title_gap = unit(4, "mm")
  ),
  Legend(
    labels = present_cells,
    legend_gp = gpar(fill = cell_colors[present_cells]),
    title = "Cell Types",
    ncol = 1,
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16),
    title_gap = unit(2, "mm")
  ),
  direction = "vertical",
  gap = unit(1, "cm")
)

draw(packed_lgd, x = unit(0.75, "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"), just = c("left", "center"))

dev.off()
circos.clear()
```

# Number of Interactions

We look to map the number of interactions between each pair of cells.

```{r Number of Interactions}
# Construct Symmetric Contingency Matrix
cell_types <- sort(unique(c(interactions$sender, interactions$receiver)))
counts <- table(
  factor(interactions$sender, levels = cell_types),
  factor(interactions$receiver, levels = cell_types)
)

result_matrix <- as.matrix(counts) + t(as.matrix(counts))

# Heatmap Colors & Formatting
ramp <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkred"))
n_colors <- max(result_matrix) - min(result_matrix)
mr <- ramp(n_colors + 1)

breaks <- seq(min(result_matrix) - 0.5, max(result_matrix) + 0.5, length.out = n_colors + 2)
legend_breaks <- min(result_matrix):max(result_matrix)

# Plot
p_heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  result_matrix, 
  labCol = NA, 
  color = mr, 
  scale = "none", 
  na_col = "grey",
  fontsize_col = 7, 
  fontsize_row = 7, 
  fontsize = 10, 
  border_color = "lightgrey", 
  show_rownames = TRUE, 
  show_colnames = TRUE, 
  cluster_rows = FALSE, 
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  main = paste0("Number of Interactions Between Cells in ", cancer),
  display_numbers = FALSE, 
  breaks = breaks, 
  legend = TRUE, 
  legend_breaks = legend_breaks,
  legend_labels = as.character(legend_breaks)
)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(cancer, "_num_interactions.pdf"), 
  plot = p_heatmap, units = "in", dpi = 300, height = 8, width = 8
)
```

# Sum of Interaction Scores

```{r Sum Interactions Barplot}
# Data Processing
plot_data_sums <- interactions |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(sender, receiver), names_to = "role", values_to = "node") |>
  summarize(score = sum(interaction_score, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(node, role)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  complete(node, role, fill = list(score = 0)) |>
  mutate(total = sum(score), .by = node) |>
  filter(dense_rank(-total) <= 5 | dense_rank(total) <= 5) |>
  mutate(
    node = fct_reorder(node, total, .desc = TRUE),
    role = factor(role, levels = c("sender", "receiver"))
  ) |>
  select(-total)

# Plot Generation
plot_bars <- ggplot(plot_data_sums, aes(x = node, y = score, fill = role)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, preserve = "single"), 
    width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(sender = "#0072B2", receiver = "#D55E00"),
    labels = c(
      sender = "Sum Interaction Score as Sender",
      receiver = "Sum Interaction Score as Receiver"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Total Interaction Score", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )

print(plot_bars)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(cancer, "_sum_interaction_bars.pdf"), 
  plot = plot_bars, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```

# Zooming In On One Cell

```{r Single Cell Network Function}
makeSingleCellLRPlot <- function(interactions, target_cell, cell_colors = sender_colors2) {
  
  incoming <- interactions |> filter(receiver == target_cell)
  outgoing <- interactions |> filter(sender == target_cell)
  
  edges <- bind_rows(
    incoming |> transmute(
      from = paste0(sender, "_L_", ligand, "_1"),
      to   = paste0(target_cell, "_R_", receptor, "_2"),
      value = interaction_score
    ),
    outgoing |> transmute(
      from = paste0(target_cell, "_L_", ligand, "_2"),
      to   = paste0(receiver, "_R_", receptor, "_3"),
      value = interaction_score
    )
  )
  
  nodes <- bind_rows(
    incoming |> distinct(clean_label = ligand, cell_type = sender) |> mutate(id = paste0(cell_type, "_L_", clean_label, "_1"), node_x = 1),
    incoming |> distinct(clean_label = receptor, cell_type = receiver) |> mutate(id = paste0(cell_type, "_R_", clean_label, "_2"), node_x = 2),
    outgoing |> distinct(clean_label = ligand, cell_type = sender) |> mutate(id = paste0(cell_type, "_L_", clean_label, "_2"), node_x = 2),
    outgoing |> distinct(clean_label = receptor, cell_type = receiver) |> mutate(id = paste0(cell_type, "_R_", clean_label, "_3"), node_x = 3)
  ) |> distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, node_key = "id") |>
    arrange(node_x, clean_label) |>
    group_by(node_x) |>
    mutate(node_y = row_number()) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      node_y = node_y - (max(node_y[node_x == 2]) / 2) + (max(node_y) / 2),
      label_x = case_when(node_x == 1 ~ node_x - 0.15, node_x == 3 ~ node_x + 0.15, TRUE ~ node_x),
      label_y = case_when(node_x == 2 ~ node_y + 0.35, TRUE ~ node_y),
      label_hjust = case_when(node_x == 1 ~ 1, node_x == 3 ~ 0, TRUE ~ 0.5)
    )
  
  max_y <- max(as_tibble(graph)$node_y)
  
  ggraph(graph, layout = "manual", x = node_x, y = node_y) +
    geom_edge_diagonal(aes(edge_width = abs(value), color = factor(sign(value))), alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_edge_color_manual(
      values = c("-1" = "blue", "1" = "red"),
      labels = c("-1" = "Decreased Survival", "1" = "Increased Survival"),
      name = "Interaction Direction"
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 2), name = "Interaction Strength") +
    geom_node_point(aes(color = cell_type), size = 6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cell_colors, name = "Cell Type") +
    geom_node_text(aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = clean_label, hjust = label_hjust), size = 3) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = 1:3, y = max_y + 1.5, 
      label = c("Senders\n(Ligands)", paste0(target_cell, "\n(Receptors & Ligands)"), "Receivers\n(Receptors)"), 
      fontface = "bold", size = 4.5
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.box.spacing = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + 
    expand_limits(x = c(0.8, 3.4), y = c(0, max_y + 2))
}

# Execution
target_cell <- "Lymphatic.endothelial"
p_single <- makeSingleCellLRPlot(interactions = interactions, target_cell = target_cell, cell_colors = sender_colors2)
print(p_single)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(cancer, "_", target_cell, "_single_cell_lr_plot.pdf"), 
  plot = p_single, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300, units = "in"
)
```

# Zooming In Two Cell Types

```{r Cell Pair Network Function}
makeCellPairLRPlot <- function(interactions, cell1, cell2) {
  
  interactions_temp <- interactions |>
    filter(
      (sender == cell1 & receiver == cell2) | 
      (sender == cell2 & receiver == cell1)
    )
  
  edges_bipartite <- interactions_temp |>
    transmute(
      from = paste0(ligand, "_L"),
      to   = paste0(receptor, "_R"),
      value = interaction_score
    )
  
  node_metadata <- bind_rows(
    interactions_temp |> select(name_raw = ligand, cell_type = sender) |> distinct() |> mutate(name = paste0(name_raw, "_L")),
    interactions_temp |> select(name_raw = receptor, cell_type = receiver) |> distinct() |> mutate(name = paste0(name_raw, "_R"))
  )
  
  graph <- as_tbl_graph(edges_bipartite) |>
    activate(nodes) |>
    left_join(node_metadata, by = "name") |>
    mutate(
      x = if_else(str_detect(name, "_L$"), 1, 2),
      clean_label = str_remove(name, "_[LR]$")
    ) |>
    arrange(clean_label) |>
    group_by(x) |>
    mutate(y = row_number()) |>
    ungroup()
  
  max_y <- max(as_tibble(graph)$y)
  x_coords <- pull(as_tibble(graph), x)
  
  ggraph(graph, layout = "manual", x = x, y = y) +
    geom_edge_diagonal(aes(edge_width = abs(value), color = factor(sign(value))), alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_edge_color_manual(
      values = c("-1" = "blue", "1" = "red"),
      labels = c("-1" = "Decreased Survival", "1" = "Increased Survival"),
      name = "Interaction Direction"
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 2), name = "Interaction Strength") + 
    geom_node_point(aes(color = cell_type), size = 6) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9"), c(cell1, cell2)),
      name = "Cell Type"
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = clean_label),
      nudge_x = if_else(x_coords == 1, -0.15, 0.15),
      hjust = if_else(x_coords == 1, 1, 0),
      size = 3
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = max_y + 1, label = "Ligand", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = max_y + 1, label = "Receptor", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
    theme_void() +
    expand_limits(x = c(0.5, 2.5), y = c(1, max_y + 1.5))
  
  ggsave(filename = paste0(cancer, '_', cell1, '_', cell2, '.pdf'), dpi = 300, width = 6, height = 8)
}

# Execution
p_pair <- makeCellPairLRPlot(
  interactions = interactions, 
  cell1 = "Lymphatic.endothelial", 
  cell2 = "Neutrophil"
)
```
